name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench with feet wide and hold a dumbbell palms up in one hand.
Lean forward slightly and brace the back of that upper arm firmly against your inner thigh.
Bend your elbow to curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, then lower it nearly straight under control.
Finish the working arm, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep your upper arm anchored against your thigh so your forearm does all the moving.
Avoid swinging your shoulder or twisting your torso to lift the dumbbell.
